paragraphs: Playeasy runs a sporting event and tourism network that destinations join to attract events and track economic impact. For destinations, the platform bundles lead generation tools, custom event micro-sites for attractions and hotels, and an AI Tour Guide for visitors.

For event organizers, the same platform covers venue selection, marketing, registration and economic impact reporting. Organizers are pointed at a nationwide network of destinations competing to host events, tournaments and competitions. Facilities are listed alongside destinations described as ready to help host a tournament, race or expo.
A traveler section lists events so visitors can register, buy tickets, book hotels and contact event hosts.

quote.text: Join the nation's Sporting Event and Tourism Network.
